events.text:
Built a linear 3-cell tool caddy:

* Center cell (0,0,0) carries a top cover with carry handle - portable by one hand using the configured handle.
* Outer cells hold divided bins: -1,0,0 has hex-bin-full-div2 and 1,0,0 has hex-bin-full-div3 for segregated screws/bits storage.

Mesh clear, only non-error loose-body warning remains.

Requirements met.
